name: 毒液噴花
prompt: Production animation sheet for EXACT character in reference. EIGHT equally spaced columns and 4 rows, 32 full-body drawings. Wide landscape sheet, maximum resolution. Column directions FIXED in every row: 1 FRONT; 2 FRONT RIGHT; 3 RIGHT PROFILE; 4 BACK RIGHT; 5 BACK; 6 BACK LEFT; 7 LEFT PROFILE; 8 FRONT LEFT. Columns6,7,8 noses point SCREEN LEFT. Back shows back, no face. Same creature identity, anatomy, colors and equipment in ALL views, never mirror handedness. Four subtle breathing idle keyframes; natural sway, SAME scale. Giant poisonous purple-green flower monster, layered veined petals, circular fanged maw in flower center, articulated walking root tendrils, no human face. Detailed Japanese manga dark fantasy JRPG monster illustration, fine variable-weight ink lines, cel-shaded shadows plus subtle gradients and highlights, consistent upper-left light. Normal adult proportions or natural creature anatomy, not chibi, no cute face, no smile. Corrupted ancient forest palette: dark/moss green, bark brown, poison purple; yellow-green or teal emissive details. Entire character and appendages visible. Real transparent background alpha=0, absolutely no paper/backdrop/ground shadow or broad ambient glow. Identical camera scale across every frame including collapsed ones. All feet/tails/weapons fit INSIDE each cell with at least 12% empty gutters on ALL sides. No grid or labels. NO overlapping neighbors; no clipping. Return a clean RGBA sprite sheet.
